name: twilio_api_key_recognizer
note: Twilio account SID (AC + 32) and API key SID (SK + 32), lowercase alphanumerics. Source: detect-secrets (Apache-2.0) detect_secrets/plugins/twilio.py; \b added on both sides. SIDs identify rather than authenticate, and 'AC'/'SK' + 32 characters can collide with other identifiers, so the base score is moderate.
